notes: One row per site x variant (main=GPP_NT_REF zero-floored, dt=GPP_DT_REF zero-floored, negdelivered=GPP_NT_REF as-delivered negative GPP), 151 sites. derive_one() reused by sourcing code/03_derive.R (gsl.skip_driver=TRUE).
